attributes.title: ASE 2027 Scientific Sessions
attributes.summary:
The American Society of Echocardiography meets in Tampa for its 2027 Scientific Sessions, June 4 to 6, at the Tampa Convention Center. ASE builds the program for cardiologists and sonographers, and it also names pediatricians, anesthesiologists, point-of-care clinicians and nurses among the people it expects to attend.

Registration had not opened when we checked. The society offers an email alert for the opening date, and it had not yet posted fees, credit hours or hotel information. The 2027 call for abstracts was still open on the ASE site at the time of our check.
